prompt: Close on stacked sacks of white salt against ancient carved dwarven stonework, firelight on the coarse cloth, one sack split with salt spilling out, tally marks scratched crudely into the pillar beside them
motion: Firelight moves across the sacks. A little salt trickles from the split seam. Slow push in on the tally marks.
